items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: But a Mr. Ralph Skull came and took me out one time.

ctx.x: Yeah, Martin's. That's where I stayed with Mr. Martin's. Yeah, they were religious people, lovely people. And it was so nice because they were harvesting somewhere out in— out from Chicago, a lot of corn and stuff. They were canned and all that stuff. But I had never seen anybody canned anything in my life before. And I was so interested in it that I— every time I talked to him, I would talk about the things that we were doing during the day. He said, well, I'm content for you to see Chicago. But I didn't know…
